 Johor MB files reports over false claims on state projects
 Johor MB files reports over false claims on state projects
 16-Nov-2026, 10:21 16 Nov 2026, 10:21 FMT Reporters Share Onn Hafiz Ghazi says he discovered several suspicious social media accounts that posted allegations online using similar sentences and narratives.
 Johor menteri besar Onn Hafiz Ghazi expressed hope that politicians would maintain a mature and responsible political culture, especially during election season. (Bernama pic) 
 PETALING JAYA : Johor menteri besar Onn Hafiz Ghazi has filed reports with the police and Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission over false allegations involving projects in the southern state. 
 Onn Hafiz said he discovered several suspicious social media accounts that had published allegations online, including claims involving projects worth millions.
 He said the posts shared similar sentences and narratives, while most of the accounts did not have followers.
 “I am always open to criticism and complaints from Johoreans, all of which will be checked and acted on.
 “But if there are certain parties intentionally using false accounts to make up stories or spread false information to incite the people, this cannot be taken lightly,” he said in a Facebook post.
 Onn Hafiz expressed hope that politicians would maintain a mature and responsible political culture, especially during election season.
 “We can have different opinions, criticise one another and disagree with each other, but our political differences should not be an excuse to spread slander or mislead the people.”
